# emotion bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:emotionBearer`](gmeow-emotionBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/emotionBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The agent in whom this emotion inheres. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): an intrinsic mode has exactly one bearer (the [`intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md) pattern).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Emotion`](../classes/gmeow-Emotion.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:emotionBearer`](gmeow-emotionBearer.md) from [`gmeow:Emotion`](../classes/gmeow-Emotion.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
